messages.text:
Monday hand-off for #oncall, using the handbook template.

Current active items:
- One open sev3, `TranscodeQueueBacklog`, tracking in #inc-4821.
- Two silences active in Alertmanager:
  - flapping `NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp` on a media node
  - a noisy `KubePodNotReady` on a feeds pod after a restart

What I looked at:
- backlog is still elevated, but not growing fast right now
- transcoders are healthy, just slower than normal because the queue is long
- no sign yet of worker crash looping

Handing off to @hq for the rest of Monday. I will be around for 30 min if you want context.

replies.text: ack, thanks. Can you paste the silence expiry for the filesystem one? I want to make sure it does not run too long.
Yep, it expires at 11:15 UTC. It was set for 2h after the node disk cleanup started.

messages.text: +1 on the handoff. For the backlog, are we still at the same burn as last night, or did it slow after the deploy?

replies.text: It slowed a bit after the redeploy, but not enough to clear. Queue length is down maybe 8 percent from peak, still above the alert threshold.

messages.text:
I am taking over now.

I see the silences in Alertmanager. For the `NodeFilesystemSpaceFillingUp`, is that the media node in prod-us-east or the eu-west serving node?

replies.text: prod-us-east, one of the media nodes. It was paging from kubelet eviction pressure, but the cleanup job freed enough space that it stopped firing.

messages.text: For the other silence, how long is the `KubePodNotReady` one set for? I do not see any follow-up in the channel.

replies.text: That one expires at 12:00 UTC. It was covering a single feeds pod while it restarted, no user impact.

messages.text: I am going to keep eyes on #inc-4821 and the transcode queue. If backlog keeps climbing I will check `redis-cli` and the worker pods next.

replies.text: sounds good. if you need the last few checks, the queue was `transcode` only, `feed-rebuild` was flat.

messages.text: One more thing before I drop: if the filesystem silence needs extending, I would rather not, the node is stable now. If it fires again, probably better to let it page.

replies.text: agreed. I will let it expire unless it comes back.

messages.text: Quick update, backlog is still open but flat for the last 20 min. No new transcode errors, just slow drain.

replies.text: good sign. if it stays flat through the hour, maybe the queue just needs time.

messages.text: Checked the silence expiry again, both look fine. filesystem silence still ends at 11:15 UTC, pod silence at 12:00 UTC.

replies.text: yep, that matches what I had in handoff.

messages.text: I am going to watch the sev3 for another bit. If the queue drops below alert threshold I will note it in #inc-4821.
